_readme: Field definitions for the log_spam webhook tool. Build it in the ElevenLabs form view; this file documents what to enter. Replace the two Todoist IDs with your own spam-log project and section.
name: log_spam
description: Call this once, right before ending the call, for every unsolicited or vague caller (Step 3 or Step 4). Always call it for business loan or funding pitches.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.note: Secret value must be: Bearer <todoist api token>. No trailing space in the header name.

body.description: Todoist spam log entry to create

properties.description: Task title. If the caller pitched a business loan, line of credit, merchant cash advance, working capital, or funding: LOAN SPAM — <company they claimed, or 'no company given'>. Otherwise: Spam — <company they claimed, or 'no company given'>.
Caller name: <name or 'not given'>. Pitch: <one sentence>. Do Not Call statement delivered: <yes or no>.
